main_instruction: Cover each block with a lid, working from left to right. Then remove the lids one at a time so the blocks are uncovered in colour order: red first, then green, then blue.

raw_labels: Cover the left block with the left cover.
subtasks.instruction: Cover the leftmost block with the leftmost lid

raw_labels: Cover the middle block with the middle cover.
subtasks.instruction: Cover the middle block with the middle lid

raw_labels: Cover the right block with the right cover.
subtasks.instruction: Cover the rightmost block with the rightmost lid

raw_labels: Open the right cover to uncover the blocks in the order of red, green, and blue.
subtasks.instruction: Uncover the rightmost block by removing the rightmost lid

raw_labels: Open the middle cover to uncover the blocks in the order of red, green, and blue.
subtasks.instruction: Uncover the middle block by removing the middle lid

raw_labels: Open the left cover to uncover the blocks in the order of red, green, and blue.
subtasks.instruction: Uncover the leftmost block by removing the leftmost lid
